findings.text: the assertion meant to show that a second flock inside an already judged function is counted reads `assert found != recorded` against the literal `recorded = 1`, so it passes for any count other than 1 and is silent on an over-count exactly as on an under-count; `assert found == 2` would redden if flock_sites stopped accumulating per-site call counts in either direction.

the exclusion proof assumes the first-started thread wins the uncontended acquisition; `_wait_for(_PROCESS_LOCKS_USERS >= 2)` only proves both threads are registered, so if the second thread takes the lock first this assertion fails on scheduler order while exclusion itself is intact.
